description: 0.13.16 DARKNUT MINIBOSS FIX07 (DKN01): the normal Darknut of Enemy Spawner only (B_TN 0x000001FF): phase 1 with 600 HP, posture 200 and progressive armour, phases 2/3 with 480 resistance and posture 160/180; FIX07: the sword really darkens with the body in the definitive death (written where the game diffs it), F1-C3 retimed to 24/56/57/40 ticks, phase-1 Mortal Draw / Helm Splitter 120 HP total, F2/F3 one native leap + one of the four combos when Link is far (90 % leap + combo / 10 % normal approach), the thrown mace of the transformation gives Link +50 blocked / +60 direct / 0 parried or dodged, Link's dodges get Sekiro-style i-frames (forward 9 ticks, side and back 6), every parry flash lands at its own contact; the FIX06 parry sequence, LGC01, DKR01 resurrection and executions unchanged; every other enemy unchanged.
